## V26.1.

### Vector Framework

> A modern Xput framework for ART and Zygisk module. It allows supported modules to change the performance of Android and other applications in memory without directly changing APKS. It's a system tool for people who know what they're changing, not an innocent switch to prove them blind.

- **Category:**System tools, root and Xput
- **Version / Version / Versão:**stable v2.2 and also exists`v2.2 canary 3108`as first release of September 1, 2026.
- **License / License / Licença:** `GPL-3.0`
- **Primary source:** [https://github.com/JingMatrix/Vector](https://github.com/JingMatrix/Vector)
- **Reactions:** [https://github.com/JingMatrix/Vector/releases](https://github.com/JingMatrix/Vector/releases)

> **Be careful:**Requires Magisk or Newly KernelSU with Zygisk. A poorly chosen module can break apps, leave the system without starting or displaying data. Do backup, use a recovery path and treat them as evidence.
